Team —

Thanks again for carving out time for Jordan Park this morning. Quick ask to keep momentum: please drop your scorecard and two-line justification by EOD so we can lock the hiring manager packet before Friday.

Notes on framing: I'm trying to keep our rubric aligned across interviews — particularly on system design tradeoffs and debugging exercises. If you think the candidate misses on a discrete expectation, call out the anchor (example: "cannot reason about KV sharding tradeoffs") rather than a free-text generalization. That helps Priyom synthesize.

Specifically: 
- Scores on 1–5 for: System Design, Debugging, Ownership/Communication.
- Two-line evidence for any score of 2 or lower.
- If you want to recommend on hiring strength, add: "Hire / No-hire / Hold".

I've attached my quick notes (very rough). I'm around for a 15m sync at 4:30pm PT if helpful.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Infra Hiring, Redwood Inference

Markus —

Uploading my notes (attached). Quick bullets:
- System Design: 4 — good decomposition of workload, asked about consistency but didn't push N->P tradeoffs enough. Anchor: asked only about leader election, not cross-region failure.
- Debugging: 3 — hands-on with tracing but needed prompting on root-cause prioritization.
- Communication/Ownership: 5 — clear, prioritized next steps, explained tradeoffs well.

Recommendation: Hold for one more loop with someone who can probe operational failure modes (preferably a SRE).

Attachment: vanessa_notes_park.pdf (3 pages)
